summary.text:
# 游客登船 / Tourists Boarding

- 分类 Category: C8 银河轶事 / C8 Galactic miscellany · 来源 Sources: events/nomads_events_1.txt:12284-12480; common/missions/missions/02_contracts.txt; common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:1086-1092 · DLC: Nomads · 审阅 Reviewed 2026-10-12

## 如何开始 How it starts

游牧帝国承接合约 contract_sightseeing_tour（common/missions/missions/02_contracts.txt），方舟舰到达指定星系时触发。

A nomadic empire accepts the contract_sightseeing_tour contract (common/missions/missions/02_contracts.txt); events fire when its arkship reaches the flagged systems.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

游牧方承接“观光旅行”合约：在起点星系游客登船3060并开启旅行项目；抵达观光地点“观光旅行”3065，再前往终点。

The nomad takes a sightseeing tour contract: tourists board at the start system (3060) and a travel project begins; at the sight they go Sightseeing (3065), then on to the end system.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

无分支结局；合约完成由合约系统结算。

No branching ending; completion is settled by the contract system.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

本导读未单列条件差异；条件随各事件在上文说明，阅读器按文明设定显示可能的版本。/ This guide does not list conditions separately; they are described with each event above, and the reader shows the possible variants for the chosen empire profile.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

- 修正：草稿把同一份合约的两站拆成两个故事；现按合约顺序连接。
  Correction: the draft split the two legs of one contract into two stories; they are now linked in contract order.
- 注：本文件的行号取自游戏文件本身；编译数据中该文件记录的行号有偏移（见账本请求）。
  Note: line numbers are from the game file itself; the compiled records for this file carry shifted line numbers (see ledger requests).
